CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.

Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. 2024-03-27 Item 10B Financing Overview of Land Purchase

South American Palm Weevil (SAPW) Treatment and Removal Plan. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the CEQA Guidelines, which exempts projects where there is no possibility that the activity in question may have a significant effect on the environment. Contact Person: City Arborist Kallstrand
1) Approve Management Option #3 for the treatment of trees on the Heritage Tree List infested with the SAPW and removal and replacement of all other trees infested with the SAPW.

Council initiated item from Councilmember Joy Lyndes regarding the City of Encinitas developing a construction cost estimate for the Beautification of the San Elijo Ave. and Manchester Ave. intersection in Cardiff by the Sea and to include this project cost on the list of 2024/25 projects for city funding consideration. Contact Person: Councilmember Lyndes
1) Conduct a construction cost estimate for the installation of this Beautification improvement and add it to the 2024/25 list of projects for funding consideration; and 2) Continue to collaborate with the volunteer group on ways to fund and implement this project.
2024-03-27 Item 12A Manchester San Elijo Beautification CMI

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
